high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "thegeekster_." The post features a photograph of two men standing close together, with one man in the foreground wearing a dark suit and a white shirt, smoking a cigarette. The other man, partially obscured by the first, appears to be older with gray hair and a beard, wearing a yellow and black checkered shirt under a dark jacket. The text overlay on the image provides information about the movie "Megalopolis" directed by Francis Ford Coppola. It states that the film opened domestically with $4.6 million and worldwide with $6.1
